gloss: to leave food uneaten; to not finish (one's food)

definitions.gloss: to leave (food) uneaten; to leave part of a meal
definitions.explanation: To stop eating before finishing what was served, leaving some of it on the plate. A compound of {食|た}べる and {残|のこ}す.

examples.japanese: ⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|た}べ{残|のこ}した。
examples.english: I left some of my rice.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ピーマン→ピーマン：11132_piiman⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧{食|た}べ{残|のこ}した。
examples.english: The child left only the green peppers.

examples.japanese: ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{多|おお}すぎて、⟦どうしても→どうしても：03476_doushitemo⟧⟦{半分|はんぶん}→半分：02938_hanbun⟧{食|た}べ{残|のこ}してしまった。
examples.english: The portion was too big, and I couldn't help leaving half of it.

notes:
Takes the food as its object with ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧. Plain ⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧ is just as common at the table (⟦ご{飯|はん}→ご飯：00776_gohan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧); {食|た}べ{残|のこ}す makes clear that the leaving happened while eating.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|た}べ{残|のこ}す: to leave one's vegetables
- {食|た}べ{残|のこ}さないよう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: so as not to leave anything
- {食|た}べ{残|のこ}した⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧: food left uneaten

TRANSITIVITY:
- Transitive: ⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{食|た}べ{残|のこ}す (to leave the meat). The noun is ⟦{食|た}べ{残|のこ}し→食べ残し：33938_tabenokoshi⟧.
